name: Samsung 65W Power Adapter Trio (without cable)
shortDescription: Samsung's three-port 65W travel adapter (two USB-C, one USB-A) for charging up to three devices at once.
description:
A wall charger with two USB-C ports and one USB-A port. The main USB-C port gives up to 65W over USB PD 3.0 and 45W Super Fast Charging 2.0 for supported Galaxy phones; the second USB-C port gives up to 25W and the USB-A port up to 15W.

Power is shared when several devices charge together. No cable is included.
highlights: Two USB-C ports and one USB-A port
Up to 65W from the main USB-C port (PD 3.0)
Super Fast Charging 2.0 (45W) for supported Galaxy models
Charges up to three devices at once
